nodes.label: Preload Based on User Intent
nodes.rationale: Code-splitting trades bundle size for a load delay at click time; firing the dynamic import on hover/focus, or when a feature flag is on, buys back the perceived latency without putting the chunk in the initial bundle. Same `typeof window !== 'undefined'` guard keeps it out of the SSR bundle.

edges.source_location: both examples target the same './monaco-editor' chunk; preload buys back the latency that the dynamic-import split introduces
